objective: Route candidate protocol evidence into deterministic Director review, durable state overlays, and fixed local validation tasks without executing model text or changing owner candidate files.
acceptance_criteria: Referenced protocol/evidence is safely allowlisted, hashed, included in reasoning, and revalidated after reasoning.
Structured candidate decisions are applied idempotently to durable overlays without modifying candidate source files.
Only fixed local validation operations may be dispatched; free-form next_action is inert data.
Deathcheck validation records three clean local runs and never authorizes prospective activation without the required collector and prospective evidence.
non_goals: Live execution, trading, orders, wallet actions, paid services, remote Git mutation, changing scientific status, or modifying preregistration.
independent_verification: Focused existing codex_supervisor tests plus adversarial reference, idempotency, validation provenance, and no-activation tests.
rollback_plan: Revert only files named in the path-specific local commit; preserve all candidate/runtime owner files and evidence.
cleanup_plan: No operational service or temporary persistent resource is created; retain test logs and validation evidence.
